title: Facebook Groups Scraper Input

groupUrls.title: Facebook group URLs
groupUrls.description: One or more public Facebook group URLs, for example https://www.facebook.com/groups/homemakingtips/.

groupIds.title: Facebook group IDs
groupIds.description: Optional numeric Facebook group IDs. Use this when you know the group ID and do not have a URL.

maxPosts.title: Maximum posts
maxPosts.description: Maximum number of group post records to save across all groups.

maxPagesPerGroup.title: Max provider pages per group
maxPagesPerGroup.description: Provider APIs currently return up to 3 posts per request and paginate with a cursor.

startCursor.title: Start cursor
startCursor.description: Optional provider pagination cursor. Use a cursor from RUN_SUMMARY.nextCursors to resume a group feed.

dataSource.title: Data source
dataSource.description: Auto tries configured providers first, then browser fallback when enabled. Provider only skips browser fallback. Browser only skips provider APIs.

useBrowserFallback.title: Restricted access control
useBrowserFallback.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

maxBrowserScrolls.title: Max browser scrolls
maxBrowserScrolls.description: Maximum page scrolls in browser fallback mode.

facebookCookies.title: Restricted access control
facebookCookies.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

proxy.title: Restricted access control
proxy.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

includeRawData.title: Include raw response data
includeRawData.description: Include raw source objects in each dataset row for debugging and custom downstream parsing.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
